Class Pet

java.lang.Object
petgame.Pet
Direct Known Subclasses:
Dragon, Ghost, Robot
public class Pet extends Object
This class represents the pet being used by the player. It tracks the pets different states, and updates the stats accordingly.
Author:
Rushd Alashqar 251377969 and Evan Salmon 251351912 and Braeden Patierno-Barker 251382353 and Michael Pachowski 251371408
